description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by Optimize: "proceed" on the receive page, https://claude.ai/artifact/UxRskxPS2PDs3j1x5TF6Aq v2; local /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-receive-proposal.html). Folds GC's "find what msg allocates from malloc per message".

Codegen emits one read-only ReceiveSite record per receive: matcher, clause count, max bound count, per-clause code pointer / bound count / closure header fields, after body. build_park_record (terminator.rs) builds ONE frame closure [outer_cont, captures..., pinned...] in place of N template closures. fz_receive_park_matched takes (process, site, frame, after_ms), down from 10 args. ParkRecord loses clause_bodies, clause_bound_counts, pinned, matcher_fn, bound_arity, after_cont.

Signal: templates per receive N -> 1 frame (measured: 1,000 x 48 B per clause per 1,000 receives); three Vec mallocs per receive gone; park-size pins in tests/fixture_matrix.rs fall. Matcher ABI unchanged (independent of fz-nml.9.5). Interpreter untouched (its own BackendParkRecord).

Not filed: step 3 (no frame when a queued message matches) waits for fz-nml.9.5 and only pays on queued receives (fanin: 800,007 queued vs 1 parked; msg and ring: all parked).
title: A receive site's clause table is a constant; one arrival builds one frame
